video: 30-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how a large language model writes a reply one token at a time

chat_window_enter.what: The chat window fades in and rises into place

prompt_typing.what: The student's message types in letter by letter at a steady pace

reply_start_typing.what: The start of the AI reply appears word by word at a steady pace

cursor_blink.what: A violet text cursor blinks steadily at the end of the reply

camera_ease_back.what: The camera eases back slightly to make room below the chat

database_enter.what: A database cylinder labeled 'answer lookup?' slides in and fades into view

database_cross_out.what: A bold violet X draws itself across the database

database_exit.what: The crossed-out database slides away and disappears

llm_node_enter.what: A rounded box labeled LLM fades in and grows slightly into place where the database was

llm_node_pulse.what: The LLM box briefly swells and settles each time it produces new candidate words

prompt_bubble_grow.what: The message bubble grows taller to make room for two rows of tiles

prompt_text_fade.what: The typed message text fades away as it turns into tiles

token_tiles_enter.what: The message reappears as separate word tiles that fade in and rise one after another

split_mark_draw.what: A violet underline draws under two tiles that are pieces of one word

token_paths_draw.what: Curved purple lines draw from each tile down into the LLM box

token_paths_exit.what: The curved lines from the tiles fade away

candidates_rise.what: Candidate next words rise out of the LLM box into a list

probability_bars_grow.what: A bar next to each candidate word grows to show its probability

chosen_token_highlight.what: The most likely candidate turns solid violet

chosen_token_fly.what: The chosen word flies up from the list into the blank at the end of the reply

candidates_sink.what: The candidates that were not chosen sink back into the LLM box and disappear

attention_arcs_draw.what: Purple arcs draw from the blank in the reply back to the tiles 'thank' and 'teacher'

attention_tile_outline.what: The tiles 'thank' and 'teacher' get a violet outline while the arcs point at them

attention_arcs_exit.what: The attention arcs fade away after the word is chosen

caption_enter.what: A short explanation line under the LLM box fades in and rises

caption_exit.what: The explanation line fades out before the next one appears

camera_zoom_out.what: The camera zooms out to show more of the scene

training_paths_draw.what: Violet lines draw from the edges of the screen into the LLM box

training_pages_travel.what: Small text pages travel along the lines, shrinking as they enter the LLM box

training_paths_exit.what: The violet lines fade away after the pages arrive

fact_badge_enter.what: A badge saying 'Check important facts' fades in and rises

world_fade_out.what: The whole scene fades away before the logo appears

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them

logo_bars_grow.what: Four logo bars grow upward from a baseline one after another, left to right

logo_wordmark_reveal.what: The brand name is revealed left to right by a moving edge

logo_glow.what: The logo bars glow brighter, then settle to a soft glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place under the logo

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow on the button slides a little to the right once
